analysis.core: Beginner taxonomy connecting securities, accounts, products, portfolio, return and risk. Stocks are ownership claims; bonds are debt claims; funds are pooled investments; REITs represent real-estate income claims. Index funds track indexes; ETFs trade fund interests on exchange; ETNs are notes; ETP is umbrella terminology. Portfolio construction is tied to asset allocation and diversification. Quoted yields are annualized and should not be confused with holding-period return.
cautions: rates are historical 2020 examples, not current
